about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) hiyye akbar 2anat akhbar la-mujtama3 el-furry b Asia, w ma2arrha fi Singapore.
about.body-2: Min3rid kif mujtama3 el-furry 3am bikbar 3ashan el-kul y2addro el-yom w bukra, w minwaffer masa7at 3ashan el-nas yit3arrafu 3ala ba3d w yifhamu ba3d.
about.body-3: Far2 GFTV mumtadd min el-beit 3ala el-2arrat el-kbire, w huwwe far2 dawli min thaqafat w lughat ktir.
